notes: DuckDB is a strongly typed, columnar analytical database. Types are enforced (unlike SQLite's affinity model). Most PostgreSQL type names are accepted as aliases. Nested types (LIST, STRUCT, MAP, UNION) are first-class and can be used in columns, expressions, and results.

types.name: TINYINT
types.description: Signed 1-byte integer, -128 to 127.

types.name: SMALLINT
types.description: Signed 2-byte integer, -32,768 to 32,767.

types.name: BIGINT
types.description: Signed 8-byte integer, ±9.2 × 10^18.

types.name: HUGEINT
types.description: Signed 16-byte integer, ±1.7 × 10^38.

types.name: UTINYINT
types.description: Unsigned 1-byte integer, 0 to 255.

types.name: USMALLINT
types.description: Unsigned 2-byte integer, 0 to 65,535.

types.name: UINTEGER
types.description: Unsigned 4-byte integer, 0 to 4,294,967,295.

types.name: UBIGINT
types.description: Unsigned 8-byte integer, 0 to 1.8 × 10^19.

types.name: UHUGEINT
types.description: Unsigned 16-byte integer, 0 to 3.4 × 10^38.

types.name: REAL
types.description: Single-precision 4-byte IEEE 754 floating-point number.

types.name: DOUBLE
types.description: Double-precision 8-byte IEEE 754 floating-point number.

types.name: DECIMAL
types.description: Exact fixed-point number with up to 38 digits of precision. Defaults to DECIMAL(18, 3) when no parameters are given.
types.notes: Precision up to 38. Arithmetic keeps exact results; use for money and other exact quantities.

types.name: BOOLEAN
types.description: Native TRUE / FALSE / NULL. Integers 0 and 1 cast to and from BOOLEAN implicitly in comparisons.

types.name: VARCHAR
types.description: Variable-length UTF-8 string. All aliases map to the same underlying type.
types.notes: A length like VARCHAR(255) is accepted for compatibility but not enforced — DuckDB stores any length.

types.name: BLOB
types.description: Variable-length binary data.

types.name: BIT
types.description: Variable-length string of 1s and 0s.

types.name: UUID
types.description: 128-bit universally unique identifier. Generate with uuid() / gen_random_uuid().

types.name: DATE
types.description: Calendar date (year, month, day), no time zone.

types.name: TIME
types.description: Time of day with microsecond precision, no time zone.

types.name: TIMESTAMP
types.description: Date and time with microsecond precision, no time zone. Variants TIMESTAMP_S / TIMESTAMP_MS / TIMESTAMP_NS store second / millisecond / nanosecond precision.

types.name: TIMESTAMPTZ
types.description: Date and time stored in UTC and displayed in the session time zone (requires the bundled ICU extension).

types.name: INTERVAL
types.description: Span of time (months, days, microseconds). Supports arithmetic with DATE / TIMESTAMP.

types.name: LIST
types.description: Ordered, variable-length collection of values of one type, e.g. INTEGER[] or VARCHAR[]. Rich list functions (list_transform, unnest, list_aggregate).

types.name: ARRAY
types.description: Fixed-length collection, e.g. DOUBLE[3]. Used for vectors/embeddings with array_distance / array_cosine_similarity.

types.name: STRUCT
types.description: Named, typed fields — like a row or JSON object with a fixed schema. Access fields with dot notation.

types.name: MAP
types.description: Key/value pairs with uniform key and value types; keys need not be known in advance.

types.name: UNION
types.description: Tagged union: each value holds exactly one of the declared member types.

types.name: JSON
types.description: JSON document stored as text with JSON functions and -> / ->> extraction operators (bundled json extension).

types.name: ENUM
types.description: Dictionary-encoded fixed set of string values; compact and fast to compare. Usually created once with CREATE TYPE.
